svg.title: An MCP call waits for approval and is approved on the phone
svg.desc: Claude Code, running as the AI agent joe-java-developer-agent, calls the get-sum tool of the demo-tools MCP server through the Straza gateway. The rule demo-tools-get-sum-approve makes the call wait for the agent's sponsor. The approver app shows a preview of the call, the rule and the agent's unverified stated reason. The sponsor approves and confirms on the phone, whose key signs the decision. Straza verifies the signature and releases the call, the result The sum of 2 and 3 is 5. returns to the agent, and the decision joins the hash-chained audit record.

g.text: > Add 2 and 3 with the get-sum tool on the
The agent's sponsor decides. No answer in 120 s is a deny.
Straza verified the signature and released the call.
Claude Code, through the Straza MCP gateway.
The call waits for a decision.
A mode: approve rule names who decides.
A preview of the call and the stated reason.
Straza verifies the signature, then releases the call.
It runs. The chain records it.
The decision joins the hash-chained audit record.
preview only; approval binds the exact call
